name: AECi — Moderation queue backlog (oldest pending > 48h)
message:
The oldest pending review has waited more than 48h (AECI-206 / Phase 5.15). `aeci.moderation.queue_oldest_age_hours` is a daily gauge snapshot of the moderation queue (the API Worker cron at 06:00 UTC = 01:00 EST; companion gauge `aeci.moderation.queue_depth`). Unlike the per-request `aeci.moderation.action` count, this standing-state signal exists precisely so a forgotten backlog surfaces even when no admin is moderating. First checks: open /admin/reviews (the queue UI) and clear or triage the oldest pending reviews; pivot the 'AECi Phase 5 — Auth/Reviews' dashboard 'Moderation queue' widget for depth + age trend. The queue self-clears as reviews are approved/rejected; the gauge drops to 0 when empty.

Note: this monitor doubles as the cron-liveness check — the gauge reports on EVERY run (depth 0 / age 0 for an empty queue), so notify_no_data here means the 06:00 snapshot cron stopped firing (check the API Worker's scheduled invocation in the Cloudflare dashboard / `wrangler tail`; the `0 6 * * *` trigger is in apps/api/wrangler.jsonc, staging + production only). The 48h threshold is a launch-tunable moderation-SLA starting point; the daily snapshot cadence means up to ~24h detection lag on top of it — tighten the cron to hourly post-launch if a faster SLA is needed.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#moderation-queue-backlog
